rule.R3: Protocol == 6 AND FWD Init Win Bytes == 0 AND Bwd Init Win Bytes > 0 AND SYN Flag Count >= 1 AND Total Fwd Packet == 1
rule.why_R3: results/diag_02: R1 also flips benign connection tails (RST first, no SYN; the client is already the source) and syn_flood flows whose attacker sent the window-0 packet first and SYNs after; requiring a SYN and a single forward packet means the SYN must be a backward packet, i.e. the backward host opened the connection. Gate: results/orient_gate/rerun_pct_fix (PASS).
rule.missing_or_nan: a NaN / missing value in any rule column -> not reversed

history.R1_proposed: FWD Init Win Bytes == 0 AND Bwd Init Win Bytes > 0
recommended_guards: Protocol == 6 (TCP only; a no-op on this data, defensive)
history.rationale: the first packet of a flow is always written as forward; a TCP opener (SYN) never carries window 0, so a window-0 first packet (RST / RST-ACK) is not the initiator's; non-TCP flows have both windows 0

Flow IAT Mean.source: flowIAT: gaps between consecutive packets of either direction

Fwd IAT Total.source: forwardIAT / backwardIAT over same-direction gaps; 0 if <= 1 packet

Bwd IAT Total.source: forwardIAT / backwardIAT over same-direction gaps; 0 if <= 1 packet

Fwd PSH Flags.source: fPSH_cnt is incremented only in firstPacket(): 1 iff the FIRST forward packet has PSH (Bwd PSH Flags is structurally 0 and was dropped as constant)
Fwd PSH Flags.how: rest = PSH Flag Count - Fwd PSH Flags (PSH among the other packets). rest == 0 -> 0 (exact); old Total Fwd Packet == 1 and rest >= old Total Bwd packets -> 1 (every backward packet has PSH; exact); otherwise 0
Fwd PSH Flags.exact_when: rest == 0, or (old Total Fwd Packet == 1 and rest >= old Total Bwd packets)

Fwd Header Length.source: fHeaderBytes / bHeaderBytes: sum of TCP/UDP header bytes

Bwd Header Length.source: fHeaderBytes / bHeaderBytes: sum of TCP/UDP header bytes

Fwd Packets/s.source: forward.size() / backward.size() over the same flow duration

Bwd Packets/s.source: forward.size() / backward.size() over the same flow duration

Packet Length Min.source: flowLengthStats over all packets (the time-first packet is added twice -- same packet whichever endpoint is called source)

FIN Flag Count.source: checkFlags() on every packet: total over both directions

Down/Up Ratio.how: recompute floor(new_bwd / new_fwd) = floor(old Total Fwd Packet / old Total Bwd packets) (Java integer division `backward.size()/forward.size()`; 0 if no forward packet)

Bwd Bytes/Bulk Avg.source: NAME IS MISLEADING: updateFlowBulk() tests `this.src == packet.getSrc()` by reference and getSrc() returns a copy, so EVERY packet goes to the 'backward' bulk counters (the Fwd bulk features are constant 0 and were dropped). Computed over all packets in time order: direction-free.

Bwd Packet/Bulk Avg.source: see Bwd Bytes/Bulk Avg: all packets, direction-free

Bwd Bulk Rate Avg.source: see Bwd Bytes/Bulk Avg: all packets, direction-free

FWD Init Win Bytes.source: Init_Win_bytes_forward = window of the FIRST forward packet (firstPacket); Init_Win_bytes_backward is overwritten by EVERY backward packet in addPacket = window of the LAST backward packet. Swapped as a pair: new FWD = old Bwd is exact iff old Total Bwd packets == 1; new Bwd = old FWD is exact iff old Total Fwd Packet == 1.

Bwd Init Win Bytes.source: Init_Win_bytes_forward = window of the FIRST forward packet (firstPacket); Init_Win_bytes_backward is overwritten by EVERY backward packet in addPacket = window of the LAST backward packet. Swapped as a pair: new FWD = old Bwd is exact iff old Total Bwd packets == 1; new Bwd = old FWD is exact iff old Total Fwd Packet == 1.

Fwd Act Data Pkts.source: Act_data_pkt_forward = forward packets with payload >= 1, counted in addPacket only (the first forward packet is never counted); no backward counterpart is written
Fwd Act Data Pkts.how: old Total Bwd packets <= 1 -> 0; old Bwd Packet Length Max == 0 -> 0; old Bwd Packet Length Min >= 1 -> old Total Bwd packets - 1 (all exact); otherwise the lower bound max(0, ceil(old Total Length of Bwd Packet / old Bwd Packet Length Max) - 1)
Fwd Act Data Pkts.exact_when: old Total Bwd packets <= 1, or backward payloads all 0, or all >= 1

Fwd Seg Size Min.source: min_seg_size_forward = min header bytes over FORWARD packets; no backward counterpart is written
Fwd Seg Size Min.how: old Total Bwd packets == 1: old Bwd Header Length (exact); > 1: floor(old Bwd Header Length / old Total Bwd packets) (mean header >= true minimum: approximate); 0 backward packets: 0

Active Mean.source: updateActiveIdleTime() on every packet's timestamp (both directions)

rebuild.Flow ID: rebuild '<Src IP>-<Dst IP>-<Src Port>-<Dst Port>-<Protocol>' from the swapped fields (BasicPacketInfo.fwdFlowId format; verified on the data)

direction_free.device / device_mac / owner_mac / device: dataset attribution of the flow to a device -- independent of orientation, must NOT be swapped

dropped_features_notes.Bwd PSH Flags: structurally 0 (incremented only in firstPacket's backward branch, never reached)

limits: a swap re-labels orientation; it cannot change which packet came first in time (time-first-packet fields keep the time-first packet)
CICFlowMeter's timeout / sweep successor inherits the OLD flow's orientation while its first packet is always written forward: such mixed rows are not fixable by a swap
R1 does not catch reversals whose first packet has a non-zero window (e.g. SYN/ACK first)

protocol_guard.doc: swap() never changes a row failing this, whatever mask it is given (TCP only)

Down/Up Ratio.doc: new = floor(old fwd count / old bwd count); 0 if old bwd count == 0 (Java integer division)

Fwd Seg Size Min.doc: old bwd count == 1 -> old Bwd Header Length; > 1 -> floor(old Bwd Header Length / old bwd count); 0 -> 0

Fwd Act Data Pkts.doc: old bwd count <= 1 -> 0; bwd max == 0 -> 0; bwd min >= 1 -> bwd count - 1; else max(0, ceil(total / max) - 1)

Fwd PSH Flags.doc: rest = flag_total - old Fwd PSH Flags; rest <= 0 -> 0; old fwd count == 1 and rest >= old bwd count >= 1 -> 1; else 0
